Explosions Heard Near Iran's Kharg Island Oil Hub

Multiple explosions were heard near Iran's Kharg Island in the Persian Gulf, with reports indicating an oil tanker may have been hit by a missile. The origin of the explosions remains unknown, according to Fars news agency. The incidents occurred in the Strait of Hormuz region, an area experiencing ongoing tensions. Right-leaning outlets emphasized the possibility of a missile attack on an oil tanker and linked the events to escalating US-Iran tensions.
